responsibility: Implements SHORTREAL conversion between fixed CHAR arrays and numeric values by combining ShortConv parsing and validation with ConvStringShort formatting. It reports conversion status and parsed values for StrToReal, copies rendered DynamicStrings into caller buffers for the explicit formatting procedures, and chooses fixed or floating output adaptively for RealToStr based on the destination array capacity.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements the ShortStr array-based conversions; unlike the .def declaration file, it calls ShortConv and ConvStringShort to parse values, format strings, copy into caller buffers, and choose fixed versus floating output.
